_about: Coarse DIVISION for a colleague, from the department string the directory gives us.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The Workspace directory has a `department` field and it is
nearly useless raw. Measured across the complete ITV directory 2026-08-10: 11,556
entries, 650 distinct department strings, and dirty with it — 'Post production'
(142 people) and 'Post Production' (127) are one team split by a capital P. What
actually places a sender is the coarse answer, Commercial or Studios or News, and
no API holds that. Sameer's line: 'knowing someone is in Commercial is often enough.'
WHY IT IS HAND-WRITTEN. A rule set over the raw strings maps only ~66% of headcount.
The rest is house knowledge nobody derives: Potato is a Studios label, Quay Street is
where Coronation Street is made, 'Record to Report' is a Finance process not a team.
WHY IT IS SMALL. You never place 11,556 people, only the ones who email you. A
250-thread sweep of a real mailbox found 106 distinct correspondents, 36 of them in
the directory at all, spanning THIRTEEN departments. This grows at the rate you meet
people — a few rows a month, not a curation project.
MAINTENANCE. Hand-edited, and it rides a normal mise release like any other vendored
file. When an unfamiliar colleague's department is missing, add the row and publish.
It is deliberately data-only, with no code in it, so it can be reviewed or replaced
without reading Python.
DOMAIN-KEYED ON PURPOSE. The mechanism is generic; only the data is tenant-specific.
The mise-home flavour is built from this same source and simply finds no entry for
its own domain, so this file is inert there rather than needing a build-time swap.
NEVER GUESS. An unmapped department yields no division at all. A wrong division is
worse than none — it would misplace exactly the senior people it matters most to get
right (see the corporate-centre note below).

itv.com._note: Exact matches win over patterns. Seeded from Sameer's real correspondents.
_patterns_note: Ordered; first match wins, and only consulted when no exact match applies.
Substring, case-insensitive, plain text — NOT regular expressions, so this file
stays safe to hand-edit without knowing regex syntax.
_cautions: 'Strategy, Policy & Regulation' is the CORPORATE CENTRE, not Commercial. A naive
keyword rule files it under Commercial and misplaces exactly the senior people
worth placing correctly — this is why it has an explicit row above the patterns.
1,236 of 11,556 directory entries carry NO department at all, so an absent
division says nothing about who someone is.
